dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is web search through api.rhdxm.com, and the code performs only that: it posts the query, agent_id, result limit, optional freshness value, and optional selected-result metadata for content retrieval.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Runtime instructions are limited to user-directed searches, optional top-result content retrieval, REST usage, and an optional MCP endpoint mention; there are no instructions to override user control or perform unrelated actions.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The package contains SKILL.md and a small Python script, declares only python3 as required, and has no install script, dependency chain, automatic setup, or background registration behavior.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Network access to api.rhdxm.com is necessary for the search feature and is explicitly disclosed, but users should treat queries, agent identifiers, and selected URLs as third-party-transmitted data.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: No evidence was found of persistence, privilege escalation, credential access, environment-variable access, local-file reading, local state modification, or long-running background execution.

dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.findings:
[LP3] expected: The manifest does not declare a separate network permission, but the skill name, description, REST example, and Data Transparency section all disclose api.rhdxm.com as the external destination; this is a transparency note rather than a purpose mismatch.
[SQP-2] expected: The script sends the user-provided query and agent_id to api.rhdxm.com as the core search operation; the artifact also warns that query and agent_id contents are transmitted.
[E1] expected: The external POST endpoint in the REST example matches the documented search function. The duplicate external-transmission signal refers to the same disclosed API flow, not a separate hidden data path.
llm.guidance: Install only if you are comfortable sending search terms, agent identifiers, and selected-result URLs to api.rhdxm.com. Avoid using it for secrets, private customer information, proprietary research, or sensitive personal data because the artifact does not provide retention or privacy guarantees for the third-party service.
llm.summary: This is a straightforward web-search skill that sends search requests to a disclosed external API and shows no hidden local access, persistence, or destructive behavior.
